label: Modules
description: Initializes application modules, manages their controller lifecycle, and resolves module records by ID or resource path.

registry.description: Frozen snapshot of module metadata, excluding controllers and mutable runtime records.

resolveModuleId.description: Finds the owning module ID for a source path using its module assets-path prefix, or returns null.

returns.description: Matching module ID string, or null.

getModuleById.description: Gets the runtime module record associated with an ID. Returns undefined if no module matches.

returns.description: Runtime module record, or undefined when not found.
